### BRINKER INTERNATIONAL, INC. TO HOST FIRST QUARTER FISCAL 2027 EARNINGS CALL


October 14, 2026


DALLAS


, Oct. 14, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Brinker International, Inc. (NYSE: EAT) has scheduled its earnings conference call at 11 a.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, to review first quarter fiscal 2027 earnings, which will be announced before the market opens on October 28, 2026. The company may also provide other business updates.


The live audio webcast can be accessed through Brinker's[investor relations website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4797763-1&h=3841173762&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F989491186&a=investor+relations+website) . A replay of the conference call will be available on the website for one year after the event.


**ABOUT BRINKER** **Brinker International, Inc.** ([NYSE: EAT](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4797763-1&h=252919399&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4425688-1%26h%3D519274511%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.nyse.com%252Fquote%252FXNYS%253AEAT%26a%3DNYSE%253A%2BEAT&a=NYSE%3A+EAT) ) is one of the world's leading casual dining restaurant companies and proud home to two beloved brands:[Chili's® Grill & Bar](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4797763-1&h=3048202851&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4425688-1%26h%3D3915248301%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.chilis.com%252F%26a%3DChili%2527s%25C2%25AE%2BGrill%2B%2526%2BBar&a=Chili%27s%C2%AE+Grill+%26+Bar) and[Maggiano's Little Italy®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4797763-1&h=2605253355&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4425688-1%26h%3D2819574127%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fmaggianos.com%252F%26a%3DMaggiano%2527s%2BLittle%2BItaly%25C2%25AE&a=Maggiano%27s+Little+Italy%C2%AE) . Brinker has grown to own, operate or franchise more than 1,600 restaurants across 29 countries and two U.S. territories – serving bold flavors, handcrafted drinks, and genuine hospitality along the way. Brinker is proud to have been named the top workplace in Dallas-Fort Worth by both the *Dallas Business Journal* and *The Dallas Morning News* in 2025, and CEO Kevin Hochman was awarded the 2025 IFMA Gold Plate Award and named a Barron's 2025 Top 25 CEO in the world. Brinker brands continue to earn national recognition as well with Chili's being honored in 2025 with placements on the *Fast Company* Brands that Matter and *Inc.* Best in Business lists and named *Ad Age* Brand of the Year among other honors. The purpose is simple: to make everyone feel special – whether it's a celebration over sizzling fajitas or a casual night enjoying Italian favorites with family. Learn more about our brands, our culture, and our people at[brinker.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4797763-1&h=1228220275&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.brinker.com%2F&a=brinker.com) and on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4797763-1&h=170533924&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fbrinker-international&a=LinkedIn) .
